title: The Thornfield Terror
description: Toman Ashcroft lost eleven sheep and both dogs in one night, and three more farms have stopped grazing east of the tree line. The survivors describe a lion with wings and fire in its mouth. Thornfield's council abandons the fields at first frost.

objectives.description: See the farms east of Thornfield
Ask Toman Ashcroft what he saw
Track the chimera to its lair

notes: High-tier boss encounter for Elite guild members only. Chimera is boss-level enemy (level 25-30) with fire breath AoE attacks, flight mobility, and high HP. Lair is cave dungeon east of Thornfield with lesser enemies leading up to boss chamber. Chimera heart is valuable crafting material. Chimera scale armor reward is high-tier equipment with fire resistance. This quest establishes Elite contracts as significantly more dangerous and lucrative than standard guild work. Threat: a named farmer, Toman Ashcroft, has lost his flock, and Thornfield's council has a first-frost deadline to abandon the eastern fields. Giver motive: only Elite contractors are trusted with something this dangerous. Consequence: the council's deadline is stated in prose, not a mechanical clock - the fields stay lost if the player is too slow, but nothing currently tracks the date.
